    Minimal approximations of the regular module by a torsion class #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_splitting_generator (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (T : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat R)) (himage : ∀ {X : FGModuleCat R}, T X → ∀ (f : X ⟶ X), T (CategoryTheory.Abelian.image f)) (h : CovariantlyFinite T) :
    ∃ (B : FGModuleCat R) (a : ↧R ⟶ B), T B ∧ (∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), T X → ∀ (f : ↧R ⟶ X), ∃ (g : B ⟶ X), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a g = f) ∧ (∀ (s : B ⟶ B), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a s = a → CategoryTheory.IsIso s) ∧ ∀ (E : FGModuleCat R), T E → ∀ (r : E ⟶ B), CategoryTheory.Epi r → ∃ (b : B ⟶ E), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp b r = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id B

    A covariantly finite class closed under images of its endomorphisms has a left minimal approximation of the regular module. Epimorphisms from objects of the class onto the resulting generator split.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_splitting_torsion_generator (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat R)) (h : FunctoriallyFinite (leftHomOrthogonal F)) :
    ∃ (B : FGModuleCat R) (a : ↧R ⟶ B), leftHomOrthogonal F B ∧ (∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), leftHomOrthogonal F X → ∀ (f : ↧R ⟶ X), ∃ (g : B ⟶ X), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a g = f) ∧ (∀ (s : B ⟶ B), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a s = a → CategoryTheory.IsIso s) ∧ ∀ (E : FGModuleCat R), leftHomOrthogonal F E → ∀ (r : E ⟶ B), CategoryTheory.Epi r → ∃ (b : B ⟶ E), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp b r = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id B

    A functorially finite torsion class has a left minimal approximation of the regular module. Every epimorphism from the class onto its target splits.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.surjective_precompose_of_splitting_generator {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {F : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat R)} {B X : FGModuleCat R} (p : MinimalPresentation B) (hB : leftHomOrthogonal F B) (hsplit : ∀ (E : FGModuleCat R), leftHomOrthogonal F E → ∀ (r : E ⟶ B), CategoryTheory.Epi r → ∃ (b : B ⟶ E), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp b r = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id B) (hX : leftHomOrthogonal F X) :
    Function.Surjective ⇑(p.twoTerm.precompose X)

    The minimal presentation of a splitting generator passes the Hom surjectivity test against every object of its torsion class.
